findings.evidence: The ads appearing on this Web site are delivered to you by our Web advertising partners. Information about your visits to Fool.com and our partner sites, such as the number of times you have viewed an ad (but not your name, address, or other personal information), is used to serve ads to you.
findings.rationale: There is no explicit mention of sharing location data with Google AdMob, and the policy clearly states that personal information is not disclosed.
